flows.text: A client signs in to the Client Portal, places an order (picks products and quantities, enters a reference), sees the confirmation with the total, and finds the order in My Orders.
An admin signs in to the Admin Portal, finds that order in the Orders list, opens it and moves its status forward (placed, processing, shipped).
The client reloads My Orders and the order detail and sees the new status.
An admin opens Reports and sees the sales summary.
A user signs out and can no longer use the session.
